title: Unicode at Gigabytes per Second
relevance: SIMD-accelerated UTF-8 validation and transcoding at GB/s throughput, providing the UTF-8 validation algorithms that can be fused into CSV structural detection.

title: Fixing Ill-Formed UTF-16 Strings with SIMD Instructions
relevance: Latest SIMD UTF validation work from Lemire, now part of Google V8 engine. Demonstrates UTF validation at maximum SIMD throughput.

title: Number Parsing at a Gigabyte per Second
relevance: High-performance number parsing that can be integrated as a fused Phase 2 operation alongside UTF-8 validation.

title: A Case Study in SIMD Text Processing with Parallel Bit Streams: UTF-8 to UTF-16 Transcoding
relevance: Original parallel bit stream approach for UTF-8 processing, showing how character encoding validation maps to SIMD bitplane operations.
